items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: and then I think Hilliard Brown replaced me with Duke, and he stayed with them for a pretty good while.

ctx.x: Somewhere like that. When the Downtown Theatre was opened here. It didn't stay open too long,
but they had shows and things, and then they left, and then I think Hilliard Brown replaced me with Duke, and he stayed with them for a pretty good while. Of course, Sonny was sick for quite --
Then Sonny would come back and covered sort of like the backup.
